verdict.rationale: Shopify POS takes card payments (e.g. Tap to Pay), so chargeback handling is a fair question for this product, but the evidence never mentions chargeback notifications or submitting dispute evidence. The closest feature is cancelling orders and voiding payments at checkout. That is an adjacent control, not dispute management, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline
